title: Chad Smith - Wikipedia
notes: Chad Gaylord Smith, born 25 October 1961, Saint Paul, Minnesota; grew up in Bloomfield Hills, Michigan, Lahser High School 1980. Drums from seven, no formal lessons, school bands; Paradise, Pharaoh, Toby Redd. Pharaoh's percussionist Larry Fratangelo brought him to R&B and funk: 'Once I studied with Larry, I turned into a musician.' Influences: Buddy Rich, John Bonham, Ian Paice, Mitch Mitchell, Bill Ward, Keith Moon, Stewart Copeland, Neil Peart, Ringo Starr, Ginger Baker, Roger Taylor, Topper Headon; the funk of David Garibaldi, Jabo Starks, Clyde Stubblefield and Greg Errico. Joined the Red Hot Chili Peppers in December 1988 in place of D. H. Peligro, the last to audition. 'Smith's technique is recognized for its use of ghost notes, as well as his fast right foot.' Chickenfoot from 2008 (Kenny Aronoff in his place from 2011); Chad Smith's Bombastic Meatbats from 2007; sessions for the Chicks, Johnny Cash, Ozzy Osbourne, Eddie Vedder, Iggy Pop and others. Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with the band, 2012. Will Ferrell's double; their drum-off on The Tonight Show, 2014.

title: The drummer that made Chad Smith feel like 'a total hack'
notes: Arun Starkey, Far Out, 22 July 2023. His first live performance was Hendrix's Fire, with his brother: 'I played it like a total hack, the same fill every time ... I didn't play that like Mitch Mitchell.' Bonham his favourite: 'It was the sheer power of Bonzo that appealed to me.' 'I steal loads of stuff ... So go ahead and steal from me.' Secondary: quotes earlier interviews.

title: Chad Smith once picked 'the greatest technical drummer'
notes: Jordan Potter, Far Out, 2 October 2023. Buddy Rich: 'I wasn't really listening to Buddy Rich at the time, but he's probably the greatest technical drummer.' Cites a Rhythm interview and a 2014 Rolling Stone list of favourites; the quote's own source is not named.

title: Chad Smith: Portrait of a Red Hot Drummer, Part I
notes: Mr. Bonzai, Mix, 1 July 2011. 'Combining an explosive rock sound with a hypnotic funky groove.' On Keith Moon: he 'never played the same thing twice' and would 'fan between the cymbals'.

title: Chad Smith's Red Hot Chili Peppers Audition
notes: Modern Drummer, 31 March 2022 (behind a paywall after the opening). Moved to California in August 1988; the audition at Hully Gully, Silver Lake: 'I walk in with my drums and there's Flea'; 'pretty tall with long hair, looking very Detroit and rock'.

title: Unlimited Chad
notes: Mark Griffith, Modern Drummer, April 2022 cover story (paywalled past the introduction): 'the funky foundation of Chad Smith and Flea is omnipresent'; the issue's transcriptions; he 'talks about R&B and funk drumming'.

title: 'Can't Stop', Red Hot Chili Peppers, By the Way, Chad Smith drums
notes: Modern Drummer, 1 February 2026, by Marc Atkinson; 'groove-based drumming rooted in stylistic funk' blending funk, rock and hip-hop. Not read past the listing.

title: Chad Smith Plays 'Give It Away' | Red Hot Chili Peppers
notes: Drumeo, 25 July 2023, 4:52. Several cameras on him at a silver kit in a studio: a black T-shirt, a turquoise cap on backwards, dark trousers, grey trainers; the hats with the quarters leaned on and the rimshot backbeat.

title: Mother's Milk (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 16 August 1989, EMI. Recorded November 1988 to March 1989 at Ocean Way, Image and Track Record; basic tracks at Hully Gully. Michael Beinhorn. Higher Ground a single in April 1989. Smith the last drummer to audition; when recording began in February 1989 he 'had actually been in for just two weeks' (Frusciante).

title: Blood Sugar Sex Magik - Wikipedia
notes: Released 24 September 1991, Warner Bros. Recorded April to June 1991 at the Mansion, Los Angeles. Rick Rubin. Singles: Give It Away (September 1991), Under the Bridge (February 1992), Suck My Kiss (May 1992).

title: Californication (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 8 June 1999, Warner Bros. Recorded December 1998 to March 1999 at Cello Studios, Los Angeles. Rick Rubin. Singles: Scar Tissue (May 1999), Around the World (August 1999).

title: By the Way (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 9 July 2002. Recorded November 2001 to May 2002 at Cello and the Chateau Marmont, Los Angeles. Rick Rubin. Singles: By the Way (24 June 2002), Can't Stop (3 February 2003).

title: Stadium Arcadium - Wikipedia
notes: Released 9 May 2006 (5 May in Germany). Recorded 2004 to 2005 at the Mansion and Sound City. Rick Rubin. Dani California the first single, 3 April 2006.

title: The Getaway (Red Hot Chili Peppers album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 17 June 2016. Recorded January to February 2015 and October 2015 to March 2016 at the Sound Factory, Hollywood. Danger Mouse: 'Leave those there, let's go write new songs in the studio.' Dark Necessities a single, 5 May 2016.
